# Model Rankings

## ⚠️ Evaluation Gap — No New-Metric Evals Yet

Last stored evaluations: **Mar 14 02:15Z** (old formulas, now stale). First new-metric evaluations expected **tonight (Mon Mar 16 evening)** after market data accumulates. All scores below are from **fresh 16w backtests** (to Mar 13), not stored evaluations.

**Consecutive counter: 0/5 for ALL models.** Counting begins when scheduled evaluations resume.

---

## 🔥 Pipeline Expansion: 4 → 7 Models Above Threshold

Three new models entered the pipeline since last cycle. EXP-36 (V2-cliff) and EXP-30 are the most productive pipeline tasks.

## 🚨 XLE BREAKTHROUGH: 4a4d8f30 IS DD 17.20% — FIRST XLE MODEL TO PASS

`[[model/4a4d8f30]]` (EXP-40, V2 DD-weighted scorer on XLE) IS DD = **17.20%** ✅, with 7.8pp headroom to 25%. The V2 DD-weighted scorer solves XLE's systemic IS DD problem that blocked all V1-based XLE models (EXP-16: 27.80%, EXP-41: 28.81%). However, IS cecpp (0.709) is borderline and IS score = 0 (cold-start artifact). Requires further evaluation.
